The candidate's literal '266b.' and its uncertainty note about the dot match the image. No other writing was found on the target leaf. The inventory's unattached physical marks (top-edge notch, horizontal paper edge at y≈3230–3270, gutter stitching, mirrored show-through, specks) are not writing and are correctly kept in page_annotations rather than records.

unresolved.issue: There is a horizontal paper edge at about y≈3230–3270, running across the full width. The adjacent fol. 266 has a shorter native height (3595) than this canvas (5120). This suggests the upper part of the canvas may be the verso of a shorter leaf, with the area below the edge belonging to an underlying leaf. It is not resolved whether the ruled area below y≈3270 belongs to fol. 266b or to another leaf. That area carries only faint show-through and no legible writing.
unresolved.next_check: Compare the physical leaf dimensions and foliation in the bound volume. Alternatively, compare against the dimensions of the next and previous image sets.
